content: Wi gin meigim plen blanga dum samting, bat oni YAWEI det trubala God na garram det rait blanga meigim det plen hepin.
Maitbi yu reken yu dum ola raitwan ting, bat oni YAWEI sabi wanim yu oldei jinggabat blanga dum.
Yu garra askim YAWEI blanga enijing weya yu wandim dum, en im na garra meigim det plen hepin gudwei.
Wal YAWEI na meigim ola ebrijing wek hau im wandim, en im na meigim detlot nogudbala pipul abum brabli adtaim.
YAWEI nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei jidan praudbalawei, en olabat garra abum panishmen.
Wen yu laigim God brabli trubalawei, wal im garra larramgo yu fri brom ola nogudbala ting yubin oldei dumbat. Wen yu duwit langa YAWEI nomo eni nogudwan ting garra hepin langa yu.
Wen yu dum enijing gudwei, yu meigim YAWEI brabli gudbinji, en yu enamimob jidan gudfren langa yu.
Im mobeda blanga dum ola rait ting en jidan powan den jidan ritjwan brom dumbat nogudbala ting.
Yu garra jinggabat wanim plen yu garra meigim, bat YAWEI meigim det plen hepin.
Det wed blanga king im garram detmatj pawa, en det wed weya im tok garra hepin.
YAWEI wandim ebribodi blanga dum ebrijing trubalawei en nomo tjidimbat enibodi, jis laik det trubala skeil weya weiyimbat enijing en dalim hau hebi det ting jidan.
Wal det king nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola rong ting, dumaji im garra gibit feyago langa ola pipul en tharran na garra meigim pipul langa im kantri jidan strongbala.
Det king oldei gudbinji langa detlot pipul hu oldei toktokbat ola trubalawan wed.
If det king gitwail wal maitbi im garra kilim sambodi ded, bat det sabibala men im oldei trai meigim det king jidan gudbinjiwei.
Det brabli kainbalawei blanga det king oldei meigim pipul gudbinji, jis laik det rein weya im buldan brom top en meigim ebrijing abum laif.
Im mobeda blanga sabi ola gudwan klebawan ting den blanga abum blendibala gol en silba.
Detlot gudbala pipul oldei gowei brom ola nogudbala ting, en yu garra wotjimbat miselp weya yu oldei go, blanga seibum yu laif.
Detlot pipul hu oldei jidan praudbala garra binij, en detlot pipul hu reken miselp garra abum trabul.
Im mobeda blanga jidan lobala en powan den blanga sherimbat ola ebrijing weya ola haibala pipul bin stilimbat.
Yu garra oldei lisin en teiknodis wanim yubin len en yu garra jidan haibala. Yu garra trastimbat oni langa YAWEI blanga jidan brabli hepiwan.
Det men hu sabi en andasten ebrijing garra bringimbek pipul langa im wei garram im gudbala wed.
Wen yu sabi en andasten ebrijing im jis laik im gibit yu laif, bat im nogud wen yu titjimbat ola silibala pipul, dumaji yu oni weistimbat taim.
Detlot sabibala pipul oldei jinggabat bifo dei tok en tharran na album najalot pipul blanga teiknodis langa olabat.
Wen yu irrimbat ola gudbala wed im teist jis laik shugabeig. Detlot wed meigim pipul jidan brabli hepiwan en gudwei langa olabat laif.
Samtaim pipul reken olabat dumbat ola rait ting, bat bambai detlot ting garra meigim olabat dai.
Det hanggribala filing blanga sambodi meigim im wek mowa adbala, dumaji im garra wek blanga baiyimbat im daga.
Detlot nogudbala pipul oldei meigimbat plen blanga ardimbat pipul, en detlot nogud wed weya dei oldei toktokbat, dei barnbarnbat jis laik faiya.
Detlot nogudbala pipul oldei spredimat ola yan en meigimbat trabul, en meigim ola fren gija nogudbinji.
Detlot pipul hu oldei laigim faitfait oldei trikimbat olabat frenmob, en lidimbat olabat blanga dumbat ola rong ting.
If sambodi mubum im hed blanga meigim sain langa yu, wal yu garra wotjim miselp, dumaji im oldei jinggabat blanga dum brabli nogudbala ting.
If yu oldei dumbat ola raitwan ting, yu garra abum longwan laif. En wen yu garram det greiwan heya im jis laik yu abum det speshalwan het.
Im mobeda if yu weidabat en nomo askim blanga enijing den blanga jidan garram pawa. Im mobeda if yu jidan bos blanga yu ron laif den yu teikoba ola taun.
Sambala pipul oldei meigimbat olabat ronwan plen, bat oni YAWEI na garra meigim det ting hepin.
